import trimesh, numpy as np
box=trimesh.load('/work/checks/assembly/model.assembly.6ad4d964.stl')
lidc=trimesh.load('/work/checks/assembly/model.assembly.2adfc722.stl')
axisY=-33; axisZ=20.2
v=lidc.vertices.copy()
v[:,1]=2*axisY-v[:,1]
v[:,2]=2*axisZ-v[:,2]
lido=lidc.copy(); lido.vertices=v
print('box',box.bounds,'lido',lido.bounds)
# closest point box->lido and reverse
def min_info(A,B):
    closest, dist, tri = trimesh.proximity.closest_point(B, A.vertices)
    i=int(dist.argmin())
    return dist.min(), A.vertices[i], closest[i]
d1,p1,q1=min_info(box,lido)
print('boxvert->lido',d1,p1,q1)
d2,p2,q2=min_info(lido,box)
print('lidovert->box',d2,p2,q2)
